name: Nathanos Blightcaller
summary: At the ruined Marris Stead in the Eastern Plaguelands, Nathanos Blightcaller guards the frontier for Queen Sylvanas Windrunner. Once the only human Ranger Lord of Quel'Thalas, he now trains Forsaken hunters and greets those who approach with biting contempt.

sections.title: The Only Human Farstrider
sections.body: Nathanos Marris was raised on Lordaeron's rural outskirts and became a master marksman and a gifted tactician. The high elves of Quel'Thalas trained him, and he grew close to Sylvanas Windrunner. He alone among humans earned the rank of Ranger Lord. The Marris Stead remained his family home.

sections.title: The Fall and Rebirth
sections.body:
After Prince Arthas and the Scourge swept through Lordaeron following the purge of Stratholme, plague consumed the kingdom. Nathanos made a desperate stand at the Marris Stead, where Ramstein the Gorger, a monstrous abomination, killed him. Raised as a mindless undead thrall, he roamed the blighted fields and slew in the Lich King's name.

Sylvanas broke the Scourge's hold and established the Forsaken in the Undercity. She came for Nathanos, just as he had somehow known she would, and freed his mind from the Lich King's will. His tactical brilliance and fiery loyalty returned, and he joined her side.

sections.title: Champion of the Banshee Queen
sections.body: Nathanos Blightcaller lives at the ruined Marris Stead in the contested Eastern Plaguelands, guarded by foul plaguehounds. As Sylvanas's champion, he trains hunters and gathers intelligence in the region. Alliance leaders know he survived and fear his command of undead forces threatens human survival. Highlord Bolvar Fordragon sends strike forces to kill the fallen Ranger Lord.

aliases: who is the guy at marris stead
faq.answer: Nathanos Blightcaller was Nathanos Marris, a renowned human marksman and the only human ever to become a Ranger Lord of Quel'Thalas. After he died and rose during the Third War, Sylvanas freed his mind from the Scourge. He now fights as her champion and trains hunters at his ancestral home in the Eastern Plaguelands.

faq.q: Why is Nathanos at the Marris Stead?
faq.answer: The Marris Stead was Nathanos's home in life, and he fell there defending Lordaeron. In undeath, he returned to the ruined estate to train Forsaken hunters and watch Alliance and Scourge movements.

faq.q: How did Nathanos become an undead?
faq.answer: The Scourge abomination Ramstein the Gorger killed Nathanos at his homestead during the Third War. He rose as a mindless thrall to the Lich King until Sylvanas came for him and freed his mind. Then he joined the Forsaken.

faq.q: Why does the Alliance want to kill him?
faq.answer: Stormwind's leaders learned that Nathanos Marris, one of the Alliance's greatest military minds and tactical geniuses, had survived death and joined the Forsaken. Highlord Bolvar Fordragon sees his tactical brilliance as a grave danger and orders his death.

faq.q: What is his relationship with Sylvanas?
faq.answer: Nathanos was close to Sylvanas in life, when the elves of Quel'Thalas made him their only human Ranger Lord. Now he fights as her champion, with absolute and unwavering loyalty to the Banshee Queen.

faq.q: Who are the hounds standing near him?
faq.answer: The hounds are vicious plaguehounds Nathanos trained himself. They guard the Marris Stead ruins at his side and attack intruders who trespass on his territory.

angles.text: As a hunter, you can learn from the Forsaken's highest-ranking trainer. Nathanos brings Quel'Thalas's rigorous Farstrider marksmanship to Lordaeron's undead.
As an undead, you share the Forsaken's bitter resilience, embodied by their champion Nathanos. He has little patience for incompetence among his peers.
As an Alliance member, you face a decorated Lordaeron hero and celebrated Farstrider who now fights for the Forsaken. His presence insults Stormwind and poses a lethal tactical threat.
As a Horde member, you can seek Nathanos's tactical guidance and hunter training in the Plaguelands. He greets visitors with caustic disdain.
